description: An HTML source file for a web-based database visualization interface, including embedded CSS and JavaScript for displaying and interacting with database schemas and table data.
external_files: fetch API calls to /api/... endpoints for fetching databases, tables, and data

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data and resetting UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying a table of data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual data cell, handling objects, nulls, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses content within a table cell to show full content.
